object.description: Setup: as PACE-STS-57, plus a second strap. Steps: 1. Select the first strap. 2. Restart the app and open Settings. 3. Pair the second strap. 4. Select Forget for the paired sensor. 5. Restart the app. Expected: After step 2 the first strap is the paired sensor; after step 3 only the second strap is paired; after step 5 no paired sensor remains.
